label: RunPod Image Generation
description: Generate a still image on your own RunPod serverless endpoint. The worker's input schema is yours — Genlock passes `input` through unchanged.

endpoint_id.label: Endpoint ID
endpoint_id.description: RunPod serverless endpoint id (from the RunPod cockpit or console).

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: Primary text prompt. Merged into `input` as input.prompt unless `input` already sets one.

negative.label: Negative Prompt
negative.description: Elements to exclude, if the worker supports input.negative_prompt.

input.label: Worker Input (JSON)
input.description: Extra worker-specific input fields, passed through verbatim as the job's `input` object. The worker's own schema wins — read the endpoint's worker docs.

seed.label: Seed
seed.description: Reproducibility seed if the worker supports it.

llm_instructions.writing_guide: RunPod endpoints run the USER'S OWN worker — there is no universal input schema. Resolve the endpoint's expected input from the user or the worker's documentation before writing `input`. Put the main text prompt in `prompt`; put every worker-specific field (width, height, steps, model name, etc.) in `input` as a JSON object. Never invent input fields — a wrong schema fails the job at the worker, not at submit time.

field_guides.endpoint_id: Required. Ask the user or read it from the shot/scene/metadata inheritance chain — it is usually set once at metadata.bones.
field_guides.prompt: The text prompt. Same craft rules as any image bone: subject first, then environment, lighting, style.
field_guides.input: Worker-specific JSON only. Do not duplicate `prompt` here unless the worker uses a different key for it.

do: Set endpoint_id once at metadata.bones and inherit it
Confirm the worker's input schema before the first job
Write results back via Quick Ingest (_inbox) with provider: "runpod"
dont: Assume ComfyUI/SDXL defaults — workers vary per user
Store the API key in any project file

x-genlock-surface.tagline: Patch a discovered serverless endpoint into the active production, then run its mapped worker controls.

prompt.hint: The worker receives this as its primary prompt
